name: Breath: Toiki wa Akaneiro
source:
The protagonist of the story is a 21-year old Hibiki Akimine who, after finishing high-school, didn't have any plans for the future which resulted in him doing various depressing part-time jobs. But the luck was smiling down on him and something new was about to enter his life. One day, while walking through town, he noticed a girl in trouble and saved her from an unknown man. Her name was Akane Nagumo, and she is a number one idol. He didn't know anything about her, but reluctantly, offered to help hide her at his place for the moment. Thus, the strange new cohabitation of Hibiki and Akane began... something that could turn his life upside down and pull him out of his brooding and lack of optimism.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/breath-toiki-wa-akaneiro]Mobygames[/url]]
translation:
故事的主角是21歲的秋峰響，高中畢業後他對未來沒有任何計畫，導致他只能做各種令人沮喪的兼職工作。但幸運之神向他微笑，新的事物即將進入他的生活。一天，他在鎮上散步時，注意到一個女孩遇到了麻煩，將她從一個陌生男人手中救了出來。她叫南雲茜，是排名第一的偶像歌手。他對她一無所知，但還是勉為其難地提出暫時幫她藏在自己家裡。就這樣，響和茜之間奇妙的新同居生活開始了……這可能會徹底改變他的人生，將他從消沉悲觀的日子裡拉出來。

［來自[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/breath-toiki-wa-akaneiro]Mobygames[/url]］
